$description: Code-side series colors for charts, not in Figma. Each is derived from the brand color (--color-primary) in CSS with relative color syntax, so it follows Customize, the ladom-ui CLI theme.css and any app that sets the brand: chart-1 is the brand itself (darkened in Light, lightened in Dark when it would be too faint), chart-3 a soft tint of it for a secondary series, and the others turn its hue on the oklch wheel with a minimum chroma, so a gray brand still gives distinct colors. Lightness differs from series to series and per theme, so neighbours stay apart and every series but the soft one reaches 3:1 against the surfaces.

chart-2.usedFor: Second series: across the wheel from the brand

chart-3.usedFor: Soft series: a tint of the brand for a previous period or a remainder; below 3:1, pair it with a label
